sourceText: Targeted updates require AudioBookShelf's 'Automatically watch libraries for changes' server setting to be enabled (changing it requires an AudioBookShelf restart) - when it is off, AudioBookShelf accepts the updates but silently ignores them. Libraries with their own watcher toggle disabled are detected automatically and get a full library scan instead.
currentTarget: 指定更新需要在 AudioBookShelf 伺服器啟用「Automatically watch libraries for changes」設定（變更後必須重新啟動 AudioBookShelf）。關閉時，AudioBookShelf 會接受更新但不會執行。若個別資料庫關閉監看，系統會自動偵測並改用完整資料庫掃描。
proposedTarget: 指定更新需要啟用 AudioBookShelf 伺服器中的「Automatically watch libraries for changes」設定（變更後需要重新啟動 AudioBookShelf）。關閉時，AudioBookShelf 會接受更新但默默忽略。若個別媒體庫關閉自己的監看設定，系統會自動偵測，並改為完整掃描該媒體庫。
rationale: The help text discusses watched AudioBookShelf media libraries and full media-library scans. Use 媒體庫 instead of 資料庫 and state that each affected media library is scanned.
